obfuscation_indicators: valuation assumptions may be adversely impacted
risk_summary: The disclosure is predominantly precise and quantitative, reporting sales, margins, expenses, liquidity, segment growth, and impairment-testing outcomes. Risk tone is moderately confident, although inflation, supply-chain disruption, foreign-exchange exposure, geopolitical uncertainty, and reliance on assumptions in valuation tests are acknowledged. Some standard boilerplate and non-GAAP presentation could make underlying trends less directly comparable.
